name: Temperature
description: Adjusts the sharpness of token probabilities; lower values generally produce more predictable output.

name: Top-K Sampling
description: Restricts selection to the K highest-probability tokens.

name: Top-P (Nucleus Sampling)
description: Selects from the smallest group of tokens whose cumulative probability reaches P.

name: Min-P Sampling
description: Excludes tokens whose probability is too low relative to the most likely token.

name: Typical-P Sampling
description: Prioritizes tokens with information content close to the distribution's expected surprise.

name: Top-H Sampling
description: Limits the entropy retained in the sampling distribution.

name: Epsilon Sampling
description: Removes tokens below an absolute probability threshold.

name: Eta Sampling
description: Uses a probability threshold that adapts to the distribution's uncertainty.

name: Mirostat Sampling
description: Dynamically adjusts sampling to target a desired level of surprise or perplexity.

name: Random Seed
description: Controls the random-number sequence used during sampling, improving reproducibility under identical conditions.

name: Repetition Penalty
description: Penalizes tokens that have already appeared in the text.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Frequency Penalty
description: Penalizes tokens proportionally to how often they have appeared.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Presence Penalty
description: Penalizes a token simply because it has appeared before.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: No-Repeat N-Gram
description: Prevents the generation of previously used sequences of N tokens.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: DRY Sampling
description: Discourages repeated sequences, particularly longer repetitive phrases.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Encoder Repetition Penalty
description: Adjusts the likelihood of generating text absent from the encoder input, for supported encoder-decoder models.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Diversity Penalty
description: Encourages different beam groups to produce distinct candidates.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Logit Bias
description: Directly increases or decreases the probability of specific token IDs.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Token Suppression / Ban Lists
description: Prevents selected tokens or token sequences from being generated.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Allowed-Token Filtering
description: Restricts generation to an explicitly permitted set of tokens.
category: Repetition, diversity, and token probability controls

name: Maximum Output Tokens
description: Sets the maximum number of tokens a response can generate.

name: Minimum Output Tokens
description: Prevents termination before a minimum number of tokens has been generated, where supported.

name: Stop Sequences
description: Ends generation when a specified string or delimiter appears.

name: Stop Token IDs
description: Ends generation when designated token IDs are encountered.

name: EOS Token Control
description: Modifies how the engine handles the end-of-sequence token.

name: Length Penalty
description: Rewards or penalizes longer sequences during beam-based decoding.

name: Early Stopping
description: Controls when beam search terminates rather than continuing to explore alternatives.

name: Reasoning Token Budget
description: Limits or requests the amount of internal reasoning for models and runtimes that support this feature.

name: Greedy Decoding
description: Always selects the highest-probability next token.

name: Beam Search
description: Tracks several likely candidate sequences and selects according to sequence scores.

name: Contrastive Search
description: Balances token likelihood against degeneration or repetition in generated representations.

name: Best-of-N Sampling
description: Generates multiple candidates and selects one using a scoring mechanism.

name: Self-Consistency Sampling
description: Generates multiple reasoning paths and aggregates their answers.

name: Reranker-Based Selection
description: Uses a separate scoring model or algorithm to choose among generated responses.

name: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG)
description: Combines conditioned and unconditioned predictions to strengthen adherence to a prompt, on compatible models.

name: XTC Sampling
description: Probabilistically excludes certain high-probability tokens to encourage less obvious alternatives.

name: JSON Mode
description: Constrains generation to valid JSON syntax, where supported.

name: JSON Schema Enforcement
description: Restricts output to data matching a specified JSON structure and supported schema constraints.

name: Grammar-Constrained Decoding
description: Uses formal grammars such as GBNF or EBNF to constrain valid output sequences.

name: Regex-Constrained Decoding
description: Forces generated text to match a regular expression, within engine limitations.

name: Choice-Constrained Decoding
description: Restricts the response to one of several predefined values.

name: Tool-Call Constraints
description: Limits generated tool calls to approved names and argument structures.

name: Prefix-Constrained Decoding
description: Restricts allowable next tokens based on the current output prefix.

name: System Instructions
description: Establishes role, priorities, behavioral expectations, and application policies.

name: Few-Shot Prompting
description: Uses examples to demonstrate the desired output style, structure, or reasoning pattern.

name: Context Window Management
description: Selects, truncates, or summarizes conversation history to control what information the model can use.

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
description: Injects relevant external documents or knowledge into the prompt.

name: Prompt Templates
description: Standardizes instruction layout, delimiters, variables, and task-specific guidance.

name: Reasoning Scaffolds
description: Uses structured steps, plans, checklists, or decomposition to guide task completion.

name: Output Validation and Regeneration
description: Tests responses against requirements and regenerates or repairs them when validation fails.
